title: automate-kms-tls-rotation-sealed-secrets-vault-private-installer
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments running in air-gapped/VPC environments need a robust automated path for rotating TLS certificates and KMS keys without manual intervention. This PR implements an end-to-end automation flow that integrates sealed-secrets, HashiCorp Vault (optional), cert-manager, Helm chart upgrades, and Terraform module changes to provision KMS keys and rotate TLS certs for the private installer. What this PR does (high level): - Adds a new operator/cronjob (redwood-cert-rotator) to the private-installer Helm chart that drives TLS cert rotation using cert-manager when available, or falls back to a Vault-based issuance flow when customers opt in. - Terraform module updates to provision cloud KMS keys (AWS/GCP) and expose a kms_key_id output (sensitive). - Sealed-secrets integration: annotated secrets are encrypted with KMS and the rotator can replay sealed secret re-encryption after key rotation. - Upgrade/rollback hooks: idempotent scripts invoked during helm upgrade to ensure certificates are rotated safely and rollbacks do not leave mismatched certs. - Documentation and examples for Vault integration and secure state handling.
